bias.en: Recovery stalling · rejected at the 100 and 200-day near $369
bias.zh: 复苏受阻 · 在 $369 附近的 100 日和 200 日均线受阻

read.en: Broadcom fell 2.1% on Nov 19 to $346.65, trading $345.14–369.26. It holds above the 5-day ($344.5) and 10-day ($337.7), both rising, and the 30-day ($336.3, falling), and is below the 100-day ($363.6, falling) and 200-day ($367.9, rising). MACD has been above its signal since Nov 11, just above zero, histogram steady; Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Nov 11 ($305.64), and RSI is 52.6.
read.zh: 博通 11月19日下跌 2.1%，收于 $346.65，盘中区间 $345.14–369.26。股价守在 5 日（$344.5）和 10 日均线（$337.7）上方，两者均在上行，也高于 30 日均线（$336.3，下行），但低于 100 日（$363.6，下行）和 200 日均线（$367.9，上行）。MACD 自 11月11日起位于信号线上方，略高于零轴，柱状图持平；抛物线 SAR 自 11月11日起看多（$305.64），RSI 为 52.6。

read.en: The $369.26 high tested the 100 and 200-day but reversed; the close slipped back below $347, holding the 5-day. Resistance is $354–358.5 (Nov 18 close, Nov 13 high), then $363.6–369.8 (100 and 200-day, Nov 12 and 19 highs) and $376.6–380.8. Support is $344.3–345.1 (5-day, Nov 11 and 19 lows), then $336.3–340.7 (30 and 10-day) and $330–333.4. A close above $358.5 would target $364–370; below $344.3, $336–341.
